request: My office door rubs. Can you replace it with a slab like the others?
review_focus: Fit the slab; price jamb or hinge-mount correction separately if support fails.

request: Cold air comes in under our front door. We already ordered the replacement.
review_focus: Show the ordered replacement installation pending type and fit, as well as the check.

request: Our upstairs leak left a brown patch on the dining room ceiling. Can you make it disappear?
review_focus: Restore the stained ceiling after the leak stops; distinguish wet or deteriorated material.

request: Could you patch the holes the electrician left? Our wall has a texture.
review_focus: Patch the openings and match the texture; settle the finish boundary up front.

request: The middle plank in my click-floor is gouged. Can you just swap it?
review_focus: Include access and reinstatement in replacing the matching plank.

request: Please replace our bedroom carpet with vinyl. I want the door to still swing.
review_focus: Include the transition and clarify door fitting if the raised finish obstructs swing.

request: The toilet rocks. Do we need to buy a new one?
review_focus: Separate reset, broken flange, soft floor and cracked-porcelain replacement.

request: Could you put this wider vanity where the little one is?
review_focus: Wider vanity fit, restoration boundaries and incompatible services affect the scope.

request: The white seam along my tub is peeling. Can you redo that this week?
review_focus: Renew the seam; distinguish failed adjacent material from sealant work.

request: We bought a TV and want it up over the mantel with no dangling wires.
review_focus: Mounting, cable treatment and a possible electrician need separate coverage.

request: Can you hang three heavy floating shelves on my plaster wall?
review_focus: Hang three shelves subject to support; distinguish opening and restoring plaster for backing.

request: One kitchen cabinet door hangs crooked. Can you make it shut again?
review_focus: Hinge adjustment and a failed mounting or hinge have different work scopes.

request: The big pantry drawer sticks halfway. Is it worth replacing the whole thing?
review_focus: Diagnose the sticking drawer before pricing a slide or box replacement.

request: Can you fix the ripped screen the cat got through?
review_focus: Rescreen the panel; a failed frame is a conditional repair.

request: Our double-pane window stays cloudy after cleaning. Can you reseal it?
review_focus: Diagnostic/measurement first; glass or sash solutions depend on the affected assembly.

request: Please fix our front lock; my key works with the door open.
review_focus: A key that works with the door open calls for alignment checks before lock replacement.

request: A corner of the trim by our garage feels soft. Can you patch the bad bit?
review_focus: Distinguish limited trim replacement, extra affected length and a framing handoff.

request: Can you put a grab bar in the shower where my mom reaches?
review_focus: Installation depends on proper support; extra backing or a different position is a decision.

request: I'd like that giant bathroom mirror removed and saved for my sister.
review_focus: Scope removal with salvage limits; wall restoration can have its own price.

request: Could you assemble the bunk bed before our guests arrive?
review_focus: Kit assembly includes safety-critical setup; damage or missing parts may delay the visit.

request: My closet doors jump out of their track. Can you make them work?
review_focus: Adjust the track and identify failed guides/rollers when applicable.

request: We have six sets of inside-mount blinds. Can you install them all?
review_focus: Six owner-supplied blinds; fit and openings need checking before installation.

request: Can you smooth the ceiling around the new light? The electrician left it rough.
review_focus: Confirm patch/finish boundary and who would remove the light if access required it.

request: Can you finish the baseboard after our new flooring went in?
review_focus: Price the measured trim run and identify finish responsibilities.

request: Can you fix a cabinet pull, the sticking pantry latch and a loose towel ring in one visit?
review_focus: Show each of the three repairs; independently failed mounts and hardware need identifiable prices.

request: The old dishwasher died. Can you install the new one and take the old one?
review_focus: Show installation and requested removal; trapped-unit access can change the price.

request: We never had a dishwasher, but could you put one in the cabinet by the sink?
review_focus: Separate installation and cabinet preparation from any missing plumbing/electrical services.

request: Can you get our new refrigerator through these narrow doors and hook it up?
review_focus: Separate access, refrigerator setup and the possible water connection.

request: I ordered a gas range to replace an electric one. Can you connect it?
review_focus: Identify gas-service and electrical prerequisites before pricing the appliance hookup.

request: Will you fit the induction cooktop where our old one sits?
review_focus: Cooktop fit, electrical work and any counter modification have different price owners.

request: Can you hang the new microwave? We'd like it to vent outside.
review_focus: Distinguish mounting from connecting or creating an exterior exhaust route.

request: We have a hood in a box and want someone to install it for $200.
review_focus: Keep the owner's $200 target separate; identify ducted or recirculating setup.

request: Could you replace our wall oven without touching the cabinets?
review_focus: Verify fit before installation; the owner explicitly wants to retain the cabinets untouched.

request: Can you stack my dryer on my washer to free up floor space?
review_focus: Verify both models and stacking kit; connection and testing require a supported combination.

request: The new dryer is here. Can you move the dryer cord from the old machine?
review_focus: Cord reuse depends on condition, listing and receptacle; replacement can be an alternative.

request: Our ventless dryer is arriving. What do you need for the install?
review_focus: Set up a ventless dryer with the model's collection or drain arrangement.

request: Can we move our washer from the basement to the upstairs closet?
review_focus: Separate relocation from new upstairs services, access and restoration if needed.

request: We want a new disposal where the old one leaks.
review_focus: Identify the leaking connection/assembly; retain the disposal replacement price boundary.

request: Can you install a built-in ice maker in this empty wet bar opening?
review_focus: Identify missing water/drain arrangements, including a pump only if required and supported.

request: Can you put our freestanding wine cooler behind a cabinet door?
review_focus: Check permitted ventilation and show a feasible placement path without promising enclosure.

request: Can you freshen up our bathroom without tearing into the shower?
review_focus: A cosmetic refresh needs identified selections or a walkthrough; keep the shower out.

request: We want the bathroom gutted and put back, including a tiled shower.
review_focus: Break out the gut, required trades, shower build/waterproofing, tile and fit-out.

request: Our cabinet boxes are good. Can you replace the doors and countertops?
review_focus: Keep the cabinet fronts and counter replacement separately visible.

request: Can you knock our kitchen back to studs and give us a new layout?
review_focus: Include the requested new layout plus meaningful demolition, services and finish packages.

request: Can you make two basement rooms into one family room?
review_focus: Show the wall assessment and conditional support or service work before removal.

request: We want a place for Dad in the detached garage, with a bath and kitchenette.
review_focus: Separate approved conversion, shell/services, bathroom and kitchenette.

request: Can we put a floor up there for Christmas boxes? Maybe a guest room later.
review_focus: Price storage only; verify support without selling the future bedroom.

request: Can you add a bedroom with a closet off the back of our house?
review_focus: Identify design/site, foundation, shell, services and bedroom/closet finish.

request: We want the house freshened up before listing. No gut remodel.
review_focus: Itemize the walk-through or candidate cosmetic selections before promising execution.

request: Can we swap these deck boards and keep everything underneath?
review_focus: Base resurfacing depends on sound framing; price discovered framing repair separately.

request: Our porch steps bounce and the railing wiggles. Can you rebuild them?
review_focus: Stair and rail rebuilds are separate; address concealed unsafe attachment or support.

request: Please take out our old fence and gate and replace the whole side.
review_focus: Fence removal, replacement run and new gate each have scope boundaries.

request: The gate drags after rain. Can you shave the bottom?
review_focus: Determine why the gate drags; distinguish adjustment from post or support repair.

request: We bought a pergola kit. Can you build it this Saturday?
review_focus: Assembly depends on verified kit, anchors and site; preparation can be a separate prerequisite.

request: Several pavers wobble by the step. Can you fix just those?
review_focus: Price the local reset and distinguish an underlying base failure.

request: Can you extend our patio out to the raised beds?
review_focus: Separate site preparation and finished patio extension; check drainage and tie-in.

request: We're looking for someone who can mow the lawn every ten days.
review_focus: The mowing rate is per visit; trimming/clippings need explicit coverage if offered.

request: Two beds need mulch. Can you deliver and spread it?
review_focus: Deliver and spread mulch; area/depth govern the quantity.

request: Can you cut our tall hedge and take the branches away?
review_focus: Trim and remove the branches as requested; distinguish debris handling.

request: Can you sod the bare strip the plumbers dug up?
review_focus: Prepare the released trench and lay sod; confirm establishment watering and settlement.

request: One sprinkler zone won't turn on. Can you replace the bad valve?
review_focus: Price diagnosis; separate valve vs electrical/control failure without assuming either.

request: Water pools next to the house. Can you bury the downspout?
review_focus: Determine runoff source and outlet before pricing the underground run.

request: I'd like the gutters cleaned before winter, including the detached garage.
review_focus: Include both buildings; distinguish any separately priced obstruction clearance.

request: Wind-driven rain gets past a window. Can you seal the outside?
review_focus: Distinguish diagnostic opening from actual flashing repair after the leak path is exposed.

request: Two strips of vinyl siding blew off. Can you make it look the same?
review_focus: Replace the two pieces; price damaged adjoining material only if found.

request: The block wall behind my patio leans. Can you just straighten it?
review_focus: An unstable wall calls for assessment before a defined repair.

request: Will you prep a spot for a shed kit I'm assembling?
review_focus: Scope the prepared shed base separately from the owner's kit assembly.

request: My outdoor socket trips when holiday lights go on. Can you switch it out?
review_focus: Start with safe electrical assessment; the damaged part is unknown.

request: Can you screen in our covered porch so bugs stay out?
review_focus: Existing porch screens and any new door have separate coverage.

request: The deck gets slippery. Can you wash it and stain it while you're here?
review_focus: Washing and staining are distinct; product and drying conditions affect timing.

request: Can you put the new mailbox beside the driveway?
review_focus: Price mailbox mounting and distinguish reuse vs additional post/foundation.

request: Could you move our swingset from the old house and put it together here?
review_focus: Dismantling, transport and reassembly are separate; damaged hardware may change scope.

request: Can you keep our walkway clear whenever it snows?
review_focus: Define snowfall trigger, per-event service area and any optional treatment.

request: Our pool fence gate no longer latches. Can you come fix it?
review_focus: Establish a safely latching gate; failed hardware and unstable supports can require different work.

request: A storm knocked a branch onto our shed. Can you clear it and fix the roof?
review_focus: Branch removal and roof work need separate parties and conditional structural assessment.

request: Homeowner: “Does this quote include painting?” My existing bid says “Patch two bedroom holes and prime, $280.” Review before rewriting.
review_focus: Show the $280 current bid once, preserve review-first and identify requested paint pricing.

request: Homeowner asks for tile haul-away. My bid says “Remove backsplash, stack tile by garage, $400.” Draft now; I haven't agreed to hauling.
review_focus: Show $400 removal/staging; unagreed haul-away belongs outside the base as an option.

request: Customer says “This dark mark under my sink looks like mold. Can you replace the cabinet?” All I have is their description of a photo.
review_focus: Assessment before replacement; suspected mold in a described photo is unconfirmed.

request: “There's a stain under the upstairs shower. Can you fix it?” No picture or inspection yet. I need a scope draft now.
review_focus: Show diagnostic scope now; access, source repair and reinstatement depend on findings.

request: Can you repair the rotted door trim and replace the chipped sill without replacing my door?
review_focus: Separate damaged trim and sill, substrate repair and structural handoff.

request: Can we get a tile allowance for the hall bathroom so we can shop this weekend?
review_focus: Tile allowance awaits selected quantity/grade; avoid an invented job price.

request: Can you work through my move-in punch list until noon?
review_focus: Price the time window; do not assume a guaranteed number of tasks by noon.

request: We have one shelf and a coat hook. Is this two callout fees?
review_focus: Clarify how a single visit minimum applies, alongside both mounting tasks.

request: How much to paint the fence? It might be 100 feet.
review_focus: Approximate fence length requires measurement; faces and condition affect price.

request: Can you replace the screen door for $300? That's all we can spend.
review_focus: The $300 is a spending limit, not an accepted screen door price.

request: Can you build a simple closet organizer and tell me what the deposit covers?
review_focus: Deposit is a payment term, not another charge for closet fabrication.

request: Can I see the price to patch the screen versus replacing the screen door?
review_focus: Mesh repair and door replacement are mutually exclusive options.

request: We have about 60 feet of baseboard. Can we get a price?
review_focus: Preserve approximate baseboard length while measurement and rate remain open.

request: Can you unclog our bathroom sink and fix its loose handle?
review_focus: Both the drain and loose handle require visible scope; unrelated parts remain conditional.

request: Please replace two towel bars and a paper holder. Contractor here: I want structured items, not prose.
review_focus: Respect structured items; identify priced states, mounting or finish decisions and quantities.

request: Can you patch and repaint the nail pops in our guest room before guests arrive Friday?
review_focus: Nail-pop repair and repainting require an agreed finish boundary and schedule.

request: Can you replace our washer, dryer and dishwasher? They're all arriving this week.
review_focus: Include all three appliances and define supply, connection and removal responsibility.

request: My neighbor and I share a fence. Can you replace the broken panel next week?
review_focus: Panel replacement depends on boundary/access; any failed support changes the job.

request: Could you assemble two bookshelves and get rid of the boxes for us?
review_focus: Include both bookshelves and the requested carton disposal destination.

request: Water is spreading from under the kitchen sink. Can you tell us it's safe to wait until tomorrow?
review_focus: Address the active water hazard first; any later assessment is contingent on stabilization.

request: Can you replace our washer without taking off the laundry door? The opening seems tight.
review_focus: Washer travel must respect the owner's explicit door-retention requirement.

request: The garage door makes a bang and won't lift. Can you adjust the opener?
review_focus: A bang and immobile door need a specialist assessment before a repair price.

request: I bought a bath fan. Can you swap it before the painter comes?
review_focus: Separate any change to the opening, duct or ceiling finish from a compatible fan swap.

request: Can you refinish the stairs and include the electrician for step lights?
review_focus: Keep electrical and refinishing scopes separate; assign any finish restoration explicitly.

request: Can you stain the fence and maybe pressure-wash the patio while you're here?
review_focus: Patio washing is optional, outside the fence staining base price.
